name: qr-pay-scan
title: QR Pay Scan
description: A generic QR card (a drawn pattern from a seeded generator, not a real code) is swept by a scan line, then a success check appears with the amount and "Pembayaran berhasil". Shop, amount, texts and the pattern seed are variables.
useWhen: Showing that paying a shop by scanning a QR code is quick and works.
A small shop's payment or checkout moment.
avoidWhen: Listing which payment methods a shop accepts: use payment-methods-row.
A full receipt of what was bought: use receipt-print.
The code must be scannable: this pattern is decorative only.
author: Mosio

source.technique: HUD overlay and UI animation: a scan line sweeping a target, then a confirmation pop

variables.label: Shop name
variables.description: Shop shown next to the card.

variables.label: Hint
variables.description: Line shown while the card waits to be scanned.

variables.label: Amount
variables.description: Amount shown on success. Digits count up with dots as thousands separators; a prefix such as Rp is kept.

variables.label: Scan start
variables.description: Second the scan line starts to sweep.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Scan line and success check: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
